interpretation: Priming improves the previously failing public first turn with the unchanged six-block INT8 graph. Adds past state, not future input or queued audio.

Later full-model 50-second run meets extractor-only average budget. Earlier slower runs remain evidence; scheduling/load/frequency not controlled across runs, priming does not explain reduced per-chunk CPU.
Four-block ablation weakens speaker selection; primed full model is preferred for further investigation.
Target-only SI-SDR declines in the long stream; projection/short PCM checks do not certify word preservation.
Total combined-worker budget, 48k streaming adaptation, 200ms latency, onset preservation and model terms remain unresolved. No live extraction integration.
